testcase.name: Signed zero and tiny ranges: t0 = -0.0 is kept; a range of one ulp works; t0 == t1 gives length 0 and one repeated point
Particle-count explosion: the largest permitted request is bounded by SampleLimits; limit violations are reported before any allocation-sized work
Sampling work: each equal-distance sample calls point() exactly once and derivative() at most 336 times; parameterAt and lengthAt are bounded too
Failures: a non-finite derivative gives ArithmeticException; exceptions thrown by a user curve propagate unchanged; overflow of the length gives ArithmeticException
Fast oscillation (200 periods): a small budget terminates unconverged with an honest estimate; a large budget converges; more budget never increases the error estimate much
Budget: build() never calls derivative() more than maxEvaluations times, evaluations() reports the exact count, and point()/secondDerivative() are never called
Extreme magnitudes: subnormal and 1e100-scale curves give accurate lengths (scaled speed norm: no overflow or underflow of squares); ranges up to +-1e3
Inversion cost on smooth curves (validated, contract 6.3): Newton steps keep the mean below 40 derivative evaluations per equal-distance sample (pure bisection would need about 6 x 30)
